svg:
MatrixHub code dependency architecture
An arrow from A to B means A depends on or imports B. Handler middleware and job processors depend on domain and infrastructure. The repository implementation depends on domain and infrastructure. Domain depends on infrastructure. Inside the domain, the domain service depends on entities and the repository interface, and the repository interface depends on entities. Domain never depends on or directly calls the repository implementation.
